test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations of the Government of India has been reporting the GDP at factor cost and at market prices?
solution:
The correct option is **'Central Statistics Office'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __**Key-points**__

 
• Responsibilities of Central Statistics Office

 
 
• The Central Statistics Office is **in charge of organizing statistical operations throughout the country.**
 
• Responsible for **creating and managing statistical regulations,** and norms.&
